image_description: Two translucent teal plastic disposable lighters standing upright against a white background with faint, blurry text/graphics. The lighter on the left shows a side profile with the spark wheel and guard visible. The lighter on the right is angled slightly differently, showing the front/top nozzle area. Both appear to be standard Bic-style disposable lighters.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects have the characteristic proportions of standard disposable lighters, which are designed to be handheld.

The form factor is inherently portable.

artifact_observations.location: Background, primarily right side and bottom left
artifact_observations.reasoning: There are faint, ghost-like shapes in the background that resemble letters or logos (e.g., 'do', 'lo') but are malformed and unintelligible. This is a common artifact in AI generation where text elements are attempted but fail to resolve into coherent characters.

The refraction and internal details of the translucent plastic look slightly 'smudged' or overly smooth, lacking the crisp internal structural ribs usually seen in real disposable lighters. The transition between the metal top and plastic body is slightly soft.
The serrations on the spark wheel are somewhat indistinct and lack the sharp, mechanical precision of a real metal wheel, appearing slightly melted or low-resolution.

Clarity of the boundary between metal top and plastic body
Nature of background artifacts (text vs. noise)
